# Kyoto 4-Day Slow-Travel Plan

A calm, temple-focused Kyoto itinerary for 2 adults, built around compact transit, local food, and low-stress pacing. It keeps the biggest crowds to early or late windows and uses subway/bus/short walks instead of long taxi hops.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary

### Day 1: Higashiyama Arrival + First Temples
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive in Kyoto, check in near Kawaramachi, Gion, or Kyoto Station for easy transit.
- Afternoon: Start gently with **Kiyomizu-dera** early afternoon, then walk the quieter lanes around Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka before 4:00 PM.
- Evening: Slow dinner in Gion or Pontocho; keep the night light with a riverside stroll.
- Transit cost: **JPY 1,200–2,000** total for 2 adults
- Meal ideas: yudofu, obanzai, tofu set meal, matcha dessert
- Pacing: One major temple, one walking district, no taxis needed unless you are tired

### Day 2: Arashiyama at a Controlled Pace
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Leave early for **Arashiyama** and go straight to **Tenryu-ji** before the busiest window.
- Afternoon: Walk the bamboo grove, then choose one quieter add-on such as Okochi Sanso Garden or a relaxed riverbank break instead of stacking many sights.
- Evening: Return to central Kyoto for an easy dinner near your hotel.
- Transit cost: **JPY 1,400–2,200** total for 2 adults
- Meal ideas: soba, yuba, grilled eel rice, seasonal sweets
- Pacing: Best day to start early and finish by late afternoon to avoid crowd fatigue

### Day 3: Northern Kyoto Temples + Quiet Neighborhoods
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kinkaku-ji** right at opening only if you want the iconic photo; otherwise swap it for a quieter start at **Ryoan-ji** or **Ninna-ji**.
- Afternoon: Continue to **Daitoku-ji** area or nearby residential streets for a slower temple-and-neighborhood rhythm.
- Evening: Dinner in the northern or central city with an early return.
- Transit cost: **JPY 1,600–2,400** total for 2 adults
- Meal ideas: ramen, Kyoto-style curry, seasonal vegetable set, izakaya small plates
- Pacing: Keep this as a low-transfers day; do not try to fit in too many temple stops

### Day 4: Half-Day Shopping + Philosophers’ Path Finish
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Do your **half-day shopping** in Kyoto Station, Shijo-Kawaramachi, or Teramachi/Shinkyogoku for souvenirs, tea, crafts, and practical gifts.
- Afternoon: After lunch, head to **Ginkaku-ji** and a short section of the Philosopher’s Path for a calm final temple walk.
- Evening: Farewell dinner in central Kyoto; keep the last night unhurried.
- Transit cost: **JPY 1,500–2,300** total for 2 adults
- Meal ideas: tea house lunch, match
